_comment: The default project is deliberately 'demo-maestrotrack'. Firebase treats
any project id beginning with 'demo-' as purely local: the emulators
refuse to contact a real project at all, so nothing here can read, write
That also means `firebase deploy` has no real target by default. If you
ever want to deploy rules from this repo rather than pasting them into
the console, do it explicitly with --project maestrotrack-3c2cf, and know
that it overwrites whatever is published there.
The rules files below are the same ones the console runs, so testing
against the emulator is testing the real rules.
